RFC9234-3.1-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent auditor, D4, owner Q-D4 (a)). RFC 9234 Section 3.1: Customer, RS-Client and Peer "MAY propagate any route learned from a Customer, or that is locally originated" to a Provider, an RS and a Peer, and "All other routes MUST NOT be propagated." Producer OTCEgressFilter (role/otc.go) suppresses when the destination remote role is provider, peer or rs and the source role (our role toward the source) is customer, peer, rs-client or rs. TestOTCEgressFilter asserts suppression for every member of both sets: Provider-learned to Provider, Peer-learned to Peer and RS, RS-learned to Provider, RS-Client-learned to Provider, Peer and RS (the rs case the earlier verdict found propagated now asserts suppression); TestOTCEgressSuppressProviderLearnedWithoutMeta covers the config fallback with nil meta. Negatives: Customer-learned reaches a Provider and a Customer, RS-Client-learned reaches a Customer and an RS-Client, so the suppression is scoped. Each set member is pinned by at least one exact assertion, so dropping a role from either set goes red; not every source-destination pair is asserted, which the set-membership producer makes redundant.

RFC9234-4.1-1.note: RFC 9234 Section 4.1: "If the BGP Role is locally configured, the eBGP speaker MUST advertise the BGP Role Capability in the BGP OPEN message." Producer internal/component/bgp/plugins/role/config.go::extractRoleCapabilities emits code 9 and one-octet role values from extractPeerRoleConfigs; reactor/peer.go::getPluginCapabilities consumes the selector declarations, including dynamic groups. TestExtractRoleCapabilities_ParseBGPConfig checks all five values, exactly one declaration and peer, and no declaration for absent/empty/invalid roles. dynamic-peer-gets-group-role-capability.ci pins the entire 002E OPEN ending 090101, then the EoR and dynamic-session establishment, with local AS 65533 and peer AS 65010. A missing, duplicate or wrong-valued capability fails the wire assertion. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. Functional judgments use the corresponding test/draft/plugin files, not the unpromoted old-syntax live files. Their inactive NO-TRANSIT import/export policies explicitly end in accept; reactor runEgressPolicyChain applies that final only after mandatory in-process OTC, and OPEN validation is independent. This is a source judgment, not a new runtime or discrimination result; parent owns promotion and native freshness before stamping.

RFC9234-4.1-2.note: RFC 9234 Section 4.1: "An eBGP speaker MUST NOT advertise multiple versions of the BGP Role Capability." The single-polarity annotation remains justified: config.go::parseRoleContainer reads one scalar import role and extractRoleCapabilities emits one declaration per selected peer; reactor/peer.go::getPluginCapabilities consumes those declarations for its selector set. TestExtractRoleCapabilities_ParseBGPConfig requires exactly one capability and one peer for every configured role. dynamic-peer-gets-group-role-capability.ci asserts the whole OPEN with exactly one 090101 TLV, including all enclosing lengths; duplicate emission cannot hide behind a substring assertion. No fabricated negative configuration is required. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. RFC9234-4.2-2.note: RFC 9234 Section 4.2: "If the Roles do not correspond, the BGP speaker MUST reject the connection using the Role Mismatch Notification (code 2, subcode 11)." Producer role/validate.go::validateOpenRolePair checks Table 2; server/validate.go::askOpenValidators converts a rejected ValidateOpenOutput into OpenValidationError and reactor/session_open_validation.go::runOpenValidator sends its codes. role-mismatch-notification.ci supplies Provider/Provider and requires exact FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF001503020B, rejecting EoR; peer-open-role-complement.ci changes the remote role to Customer, requires EoR and rejects 03020B. TestValidateOpenRolePair_ValidPairs and InvalidPairs pin accept/refuse and exact codes; TestValidateOpenRolePairRunsForADynamicGroupMember also checks group lookup, refusal and complementary acceptance. Server TestBroadcastValidateOpenRefusesAnUnansweredPerPeerPolicy, TestAskOpenValidatorsLeavesASilentPluginPending and TestBroadcastValidateOpenAcceptsAPeerWithNoPerPeerPolicy retain the owner-selected fail-closed plumbing: those are supplemental robustness evidence, not a claim that the RFC equates plugin silence with an observed role mismatch. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. Functional judgments use the corresponding test/draft/plugin files, not the unpromoted old-syntax live files. RFC9234-4.2-3.note: RFC 9234 Section 4.2: "If multiple BGP Role Capabilities are received and not all of them have the same value, then the BGP speaker MUST reject the connection using the Role Mismatch Notification (code 2, subcode 11)." The complementary sentence is: "If an eBGP speaker receives multiple but identical BGP Role Capabilities with the same value in each, then the speaker considers them to be a single BGP Role Capability and proceeds [RFC5492]." Producer role/validate.go::validateOpenRolePair compares values, not just the count; server askOpenValidators and session runOpenValidator consume the refusal. role-multiple-roles-notification.ci sends Customer then Peer against Provider, requires exact NOTIFICATION 2/11 and no EoR; Customer alone corresponds, isolating the second differing value. role-multiple-same-roles.ci sends Customer twice, requires EoR and rejects 03020B. TestValidateOpenRolePair_MultipleDifferentRoles pins false, 2/11 and the multiple reason; MultipleSameRoles pins true. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. Functional judgments use the corresponding test/draft/plugin files, not the unpromoted old-syntax live files. RFC9234-4.2-5.note: RFC 9234 Section 4.2: "An operator may choose to apply a "strict mode" in which the receipt of a BGP Role Capability from the remote AS is required." "When operating in the "strict mode", if the BGP Role Capability is sent but one is not received, the connection is rejected using the Role Mismatch Notification (code 2, subcode 11)." role/validate.go::validateOpenRolePair branches on cfg.strict when peerRoles is empty. role-strict-enforcement.ci configures customer and strict true, drops capability 9 from the remote OPEN and requires exact NOTIFICATION 2/11. TestValidateOpenStrictModeRefusesADynamicGroupMemberWithNoRole checks strict refusal with 2/11 and acceptance of the corresponding group member; TestValidateOpenRolePair_NoPeerRole_NoStrict accepts a missing remote role with strict false. The adjacent backward-compatibility sentence says SHOULD ignore absence, not MUST; the negative pins the chosen non-strict behavior without upgrading that SHOULD. The functional fixture remains ASN 1/1 as before; it is supplemented by the role/group unit controls, not described as an eBGP wire fixture. TestRFC9234OTCStampedToEveryDownstreamDestination checks exactly one four-octet set operation with 65000 for Customer, Peer and RS-Client; TestRFC9234OTCNotStampedOutsideTheDownstreamScope covers Provider/RS with real NLRI and existing OTC toward Customer.
